description: This file implements the management of external data (ex_data) in OpenSSL, including functions for creating, setting, retrieving, and freeing external data associated with cryptographic objects.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_ex_new_index
methods.description: Allocates a new index for external data, associating it with a class and optional free function.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_ex_data
methods.description: Associates a value with a specific index in the external data of an object.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_ex_data
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific index in the external data of an object.

methods.name: CRYPTO_new_ex_data
methods.description: Initializes a new external data structure.

methods.name: CRYPTO_free_ex_data
methods.description: Frees external data associated with an object, calling registered free functions.

methods.name: CRYPTO_cleanup_all_ex_data
methods.description: Performs cleanup of all external data (empty implementation).
